sessions.title: Hill climbing for agents: From 60% to 90% with Open Source and Foundry
sessions.desc:

sessions.desc:

sessions.title: Own your intelligence with Fireworks on Foundry
sessions.desc: Your organization’s data can be the key to creating differentiated AI experiences with open models. Discover how customers use Fireworks on Foundry to customize models for their domains while helping lower costs. For architects and technical leaders evaluating open models, explore which workloads to consider, what training is needed, and how shifting 2% of weights can propel an application past its category.

sessions.title: Could agent stores do for AI what app stores did for software?
sessions.desc: What if adopting AI became as simple as selecting the right solution instead of launching a new development project? Explore why this emerging model is gaining momentum and how pre-built AI agents can help businesses accelerate productivity, streamline operations, and create faster paths to value. Join Sunny Wang for a fast-paced conversation on how agent stores can make AI more accessible, scalable, and actionable for businesses.

sessions.title: Turn AI speed into trusted outcomes
sessions.desc: AI can generate software and agents faster than enterprises can confidently deploy and operate them. Explore how HARC Compose connects business intent and governed context with AI-led and failure-conscious engineering to help bridge that gap. See how teams can move more quickly with greater assurance, govern agent behavior, and build trusted products for mission-critical environments while keeping people in control of consequential decisions.

sessions.title: Build secure agents across the Microsoft stack
sessions.desc: Anyone can build a demo agent. Shipping one that's secure and production-ready is the hard part. Learn how to build production-ready agents across the Microsoft stack, from Copilot Studio for business users to Microsoft Foundry for pro-code development, with security and governance considered from day one. Neither was ready on day one. We'll show the governance work each one needed, what broke early, and a short checklist to run before you hand your next agent the keys.
sessions.room: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 2

sessions.title: Theory to revenue: build a Microsoft practice that fits your stage
sessions.desc: Discover how top software and AI companies accelerate growth by building a strong Microsoft partner practice. Drawing on lessons from leading Microsoft partners like Citrix and Redis, and from building and running Microsoft's exclusive high-growth startups program, learn how to apply the same partner frameworks to maximize revenue, align with Microsoft's priorities, and scale faster in FY27. Leave ready to grow your own Microsoft partnership with practical, proven strategies.
sessions.room: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 5

sessions.title: Same Migration, Two Payouts: How Your Routing Decides a Deal's Worth
sessions.desc: Two partners move identical workloads to Azure. One earns materially more than the other, and the difference is not technical. It is how the opportunity was routed before any work started. This talk covers that routing decision: when it has to be made, who makes it, who inside Microsoft has to be involved, and what it is worth to get right. Aimed at partners running server, SQL, or VMware migration practices who are leaving money behind without knowing it.
sessions.room: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 2

sessions.title: Could You Pass the New Security Specialization Audit Today?
sessions.desc: The bar has been raised for earning Microsoft Security Specializations, with partners needing to pass a third-party audit. Join this panel to learn what's changing, where partners commonly fall short, and how to prepare before timelines become compressed. Experts who've helped 40+ partners through specialization audits will share guidance on documentation, customer evidence, operational readiness, and audit preparation.
sessions.room: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 8

sessions.title: Bring Microsoft passkeys to frontline and shared devices
sessions.desc: Microsoft is expanding passkey-based authentication through experiences such as Windows Hello for Business and Microsoft Authenticator. IDmelon builds on this direction by bringing simple, phishing-resistant authentication to frontline workers using shared PCs, kiosks, and mobile devices. See how workers can use the same access badge they already carry to sign in with a simple tap without changing familiar workflows.
sessions.room: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 2

sessions.title: From data to decisions: Building an agentic enterprise at Renaissance
sessions.desc: Agentic AI delivers value when it goes beyond answering questions to connecting trusted data, understanding business context, and enabling action. Hear how Genpact and Microsoft are helping Renaissance Benefits apply this approach across finance and actuarial operations using Microsoft Fabric, Copilot, machine learning, and responsible AI. Explore real-world decisions, challenges, and lessons in turning agentic AI into business value.
sessions.room: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 1

sessions.title: Build confidence in Copilot answers that matter most
sessions.desc: Some AI answers require a higher level of confidence, particularly when regulatory, financial, safety, or reputational considerations are involved. In this conversational lightning talk, getAbstract shares four checks for the answers that matter most: curated sources, current knowledge, clear attribution, and human verification. Learn how a verified knowledge layer can strengthen AI responses for higher-stakes scenarios and help you apply these checks to your own Copilot and AI agent use cases.
sessions.room: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 7

sessions.title: Accelerate agentic AI at the edge and data center with Azure Local
sessions.desc: See how Wipro is using Azure Local with Intel and Dell technologies to support secure, scalable agentic AI at the edge and in the data center. In this live demonstration, explore Wipro’s uEdgeAI and AI DC capabilities and learn how this approach can help accelerate the agentic AI journey and enable autonomous enterprise decision-making.
sessions.room: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 2

sessions.title: Secure the edge. Protect your data
sessions.desc: Learn how to secure private application access, apply Purview data-loss policies, and protect users and sensitive information wherever work happens. See how Cisco SASE extends Microsoft Edge and Purview with unified, zero-trust access and data protection.
sessions.room: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 4

sessions.title: Your AI agent needs more than a prompt and a prayer
sessions.desc: A great demo doesn't guarantee production success. Before your AI agent starts racking up token bills or making creative assumptions, learn how Dell Services helps organizations map the right use cases, ground agents in trusted, secure data, and govern spend with FinOps and tokenomics. Walk away with a practical playbook for running Microsoft AI agents at scale.
sessions.room: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 6

sessions.title: Build once, apply everywhere: A blueprint for financial services AI
sessions.desc: As agentic AI scales, enterprises need a unified approach to build, manage, secure, and govern agents. See how Capco combines Microsoft technologies with deep financial services expertise to create an agentic AI blueprint that brings together industry context, architecture patterns, and controls. Learn how this approach can help organizations build secure, scalable AI solutions for financial services.
sessions.room: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 3

sessions.title: Unify data management and resilience across hybrid cloud
sessions.desc: Explore how Wipro IDSS brings together data, AI, cloud, cyber resilience, and FinOps to support unified data management across multihybrid cloud environments. See how Wipro, with Everpure and Rubrik, approaches data protection, cyber resilience, and seamless data mobility to help organizations manage data across complex cloud environments.
sessions.room: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 1

sessions.title: Optimize AI routing and lower costs with NVIDIA SwitchYard
sessions.desc: AI coding assistants deliver powerful results, but every token comes at a cost. Experience NVIDIA SwitchYard, an AI router that connects tools such as Cursor and Codex to Microsoft Foundry and local models. See real examples of routing configurations designed to optimize token usage and lower AI costs.
sessions.room: The Aviary, Lightning Talks

sessions.title: From Digital Twins to Physical AI:Azure Meets NVIDIA Omniverse & cuOpt
sessions.desc: How do optimized routes in a digital factory connect to robots in the real world? This lightning talk explores an architecture combining Azure, NVIDIA Omniverse, and cuOpt to compute routes and visualize them in a simulated factory. We’ll examine how NVIDIA cuOpt may be used with Isaac Sim to optimize factory operations in real time.
sessions.room: The Aviary, Lightning Talks

sessions.title: Fine-tune NVIDIA Nemotron models with Azure Databricks AI Runtime
sessions.desc: Learn how to turn an open model into one that understands your business data. Join Azure Databricks and NVIDIA for a hands-on walkthrough of post-training with AI Runtime and NVIDIA Nemotron models. Using receipt extraction as a multimodal example, see how to prepare labeled data, adapt a model with NVIDIA NeMo, and compare base and fine-tuned results. We'll also cover serverless GPU infrastructure and key security, governance, and operational considerations.
sessions.room: The Aviary, Lightning Talks

sessions.title: Understand how attackers use AI to create and evade malware
sessions.desc: AI is changing how attackers create, evade detection, and deliver malware, while giving defenders new ways to identify threats. See demonstrations of AI-assisted malware creation, exploit detection, and delivery methods, and learn how to distinguish human-driven techniques from those enabled by AI.

sessions.title: Streamline Microsoft 365 administration with AI agents
sessions.desc: Microsoft 365 administration still means jumping between portals, reports, exports, and scripts. In 20 minutes, Microsoft MVP Richard Harbridge shows how AI agents and MCP can shorten that path. See agents investigate governance data, prioritize risk, generate evidence, and prepare action while keeping human approval, permissions, and accountability clear.

sessions.title: Beyond tickets: Build the autonomous workplace
sessions.desc: The future of workplace operations is not resolving tickets faster. It is eliminating the need for them. Learn how TeamViewer works with Microsoft technologies to use endpoint intelligence, AI-powered knowledge capture, and self-healing automation to predict and prevent digital friction. See how consolidated IT workflows can turn successful fixes into automations that reduce resolution time and give IT teams time back for higher-value work.

sessions.title: Build identity resilience across Microsoft Entra ID and Intune
sessions.desc: As AI, automation, and cloud services expand the identity surface, Microsoft Entra ID and Intune become even more critical to access and business continuity. Explore a practical identity resilience model built around change visibility, configuration control, targeted recovery, and continuity planning, and see how Backupta helps teams keep Microsoft identity operations dependable as environments become more dynamic.

sessions.title: Build the data layer for enterprise AI
sessions.desc: Enterprise data is scattered across SQL Server, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, and other systems. Learn how to unify that data in OneLake, continuously extract and maintain context from operational data, and bring it into Fabric IQ so Copilot, AI agents, and Power BI can work across enterprise data without adding more pipelines, compute, storage, or data movement. The result is an AI-ready data foundation that makes enterprise context easier to access and put to work.
speakers: Sr. Director and GPM, Microsoft OneLake

sessions.title: Intel Assured Supply Chain: Enhancing supply chain resilience
sessions.desc: Ensuring the manufacturing provenance of hardware is critical for customers to minimize financial losses, reputational damage, system downtime, and recovery delays caused by counterfeit‑related hardware risks. This video introduces Intel® Assured Supply Chain, a modern supply chain security solution that enhances transparency in semiconductor manufacturing by delivering a digitally attestable chain of custody for each chip.

sessions.title: Build trustworthy AI: Cohere’s sovereign framework
sessions.desc: Leaders across every industry highlight data leakage, privacy, compliance, and regulatory risk as top concerns. In this session, we'll talk about what sovereign AI really means and identify the blockers slowing down the adoption of sovereign AI.

sessions.title: Move beyond AI pilots and build the frontier firm
sessions.desc: Most organizations have moved past asking whether AI delivers value. The challenge now is scaling it. Many have deployed AI platforms and piloted agents, but few have built the governance and digital foundations required for enterprise-wide transformation. Learn how to move from isolated AI wins to business-wide impact through agent governance, operating models, and responsible adoption practices. Leave with a practical framework for scaling AI across your organization.

sessions.title: Turn personal agents into enterprise assets
sessions.desc: AI is moving beyond individual assistance toward enterprise agents that work across teams, data, and systems. EY explores how organizations can select agents, govern data access, scale personal agents into enterprise assets, and balance speed, risk, and human accountability. Gain a practical view of the operating models, validation approaches, controls, and ways of working needed to move from copilots and experimentation to responsible, scalable AI agent ecosystems.

sessions.title: Frontier-driven AI: Evaluating LLMs at scale
sessions.desc: Enterprises are adopting foundation models at an unprecedented pace, creating new challenges around governance, risk, cost, and model quality. This demo shows an automated evaluation and promotion framework built on Microsoft Foundry, using benchmark datasets, safety testing, and cost analysis to assess candidate models. Attendees will see how organizations can establish trusted baselines, automate decision-making, and deploy AI solutions with governance and operational controls at scale.

sessions.title: The wire stalled. The closing didn’t. AI agents for regulated banking.
sessions.desc: Wires and sanctions holds run across systems, rules, and reviewers. Most AI agents can’t carry that work to a consistent outcome. See how enterprise AI can be grounded in trusted data, governed across complex workflows, and continuously evaluated at every step, using Kore.ai pre-built agents on Microsoft Azure.

sessions.title: Multimodal agents: Muse Spark Open in Microsoft Foundry Models
sessions.desc: Explore Muse Spark Open's multimodal capabilities, available through the Hugging Face collection in Microsoft Foundry Models. With text, image, video, and audio inputs and a 1M-token context window, Meta's open-weight model can reason across what it sees, hears, and reads. Learn how developers can connect documents, screenshots, and recordings with code and tasks and combine multimodal understanding with tool calling in an agentic harness.

sessions.title: Your path from AI pilots to a Frontier Firm
sessions.desc: What defines a Frontier Firm, and how does an organization become one? Explore a practical path from individual AI use to governed agents and redesigned workflows. Learn which activities matter, where Microsoft 365 E7 fits, and how SoftwareOne services support readiness, adoption, security, and ongoing operations. Leave with a framework to choose your next steps.

sessions.title: Unlocking AI workflows: A blueprint for leading teams
sessions.desc: Every organization is adopting AI, but what does it take to become truly AI-native? Discover a practical blueprint for moving from early experimentation to operational transformation with Atlassian Rovo. Learn how leading teams evolved from manual processes to deploying AI agents that run in the background, surface critical insights, and power everyday workflows across delivery, operations, and knowledge management.

sessions.title: AI-supported decision making in transport: Optimizing split orders
sessions.desc: When delivery routes exceed truck capacity, planners make rapid decisions that affect cost, service levels, and operational efficiency. EPAM and Ahold Delhaize share how they captured expert planner knowledge and turned it into an AI-powered decision-support solution built on Microsoft AI. Learn how AI, real-time optimization, and human-in-the-loop decision making reduced standby truck usage, improved route utilization, and created a foundation for intelligent supply chain operations.

sessions.title: Any source to Azure: Infrastructure, applications & databases together
sessions.desc: Enterprise migrations fail when infrastructure, application, and database workstreams run separately. Each team handoff is a potential failure point. Concierto's unified AI platform assesses, migrates, and modernizes all three layers together in a single coordinated execution, from any source to Azure. One assessment pass covers your entire estate. One platform takes it to completion - in weeks, not the several months that fragmented approaches routinely take.

sessions.title: The adaptive enterprise: Ready for what’s next
sessions.desc: AI, evolving security threats, workforce expectations, and greater IT complexity change what enterprises need from technology. In this on-demand session, Brian Madden explores what it means to become an adaptive enterprise and how Citrix helps organizations respond to change with greater agility, resilience, and control while they provide secure, high-performance work experiences across complex environments.

sessions.title: Accelerate safe AI with three essential checks
sessions.desc: AI mistakes are happening. Learn three key things to help you confidently scale AI with Microsoft 365 and Veeam. See what AI can actually reach, clean up what it shouldn't, and keep the whole estate recoverable if needed. You'll leave with three checks to run before your next AI rollout.

sessions.title: Your apps are down. What comes back first?
sessions.desc:
When Exchange, SharePoint, and Teams go down together, most IT teams have backup, but no plan for what comes back first. Rubrik heard this everywhere, including from Simpson Strong-Tie: nobody had defined critical people in advance, so recovery got improvised, costing days.
In this fireside, Varun Grover and Mohammad Akram cover Autonomous Business Recovery: restoring the Minimum Viable Company first. Recovery that took 7-10 days now lands under 3 hours.
speakers: Director of Product Marketing, AI & SaaS

sessions.title: What should you expect from Enterprise Linux today?
sessions.desc: Learn what to consider when building a Linux environment that can stay secure, consistent, and manageable across your enterprise. Explore four key areas: silicon and cloud compatibility, ecosystem support, codebase consistency, and security and compliance. See how Ubuntu and Landscape put these principles into practice with fleet management and automation, plus integration with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.

sessions.title: Accelerate mission-critical modernization with agentic AI
sessions.desc: Modernizing mission-critical systems is complex, but delaying change can increase risk. Join Kyndryl and Microsoft to explore how agentic AI can accelerate modernization across complex application estates while maintaining governance, resiliency, and control. Learn how AI-powered insights help assess workloads, prioritize opportunities, reduce complexity, and speed transformation. Discover practical approaches that deliver measurable business value and support an AI-ready future.

sessions.title: Demystify Oracle AI database to Azure migrations
sessions.desc: Think migrating Oracle AI Database from an on-premises environment to Azure is complex and risky? Think again. Discover a proven framework that takes the guesswork out of migration. See how Oracle Zero Downtime Migration minimizes disruption, and how programs like Microsoft Cloud Accelerate Factory provide deployment assistance and architecture guidance from Azure experts. Gain the tools, expertise, and confidence to plan and execute a smooth migration to Oracle AI Database@Azure.

sessions.title: The click your Zero Trust strategy needs to watch
sessions.desc: Zero Trust verifies your laptops and servers, but what happens when an AI agent reads, classifies, and routes every document moving through your print and scan environment? Corey Ercanbrack, CTO of Vasion, runs a live audit: agent identity against verify explicitly, folder scope against least privilege, and a hidden prompt inside a real document against assume breach. Walk out with three questions to take back to your own security team.

sessions.title: Go beyond the license to govern Copilot adoption and AI budget
sessions.desc: Getting value from Copilot goes beyond licensing. Adoption efforts can rely on guesswork, and requests for more tokens can be inconsistent and ungoverned. This session tackles both challenges. Organizations that succeed with Copilot run targeted adoption campaigns and turn requests for additional AI budget into a governed cycle tied to stated business needs. Join this session to learn how to turn your Copilot investment into ROI you can prove.

sessions.title: Protect the endpoint before Windows even loads
sessions.desc: AI-era threats don’t wait for Windows to load, so endpoint security can’t either. Discover ASUS ExpertGuardian, the enterprise-grade, multi-layer security architecture built into ASUS ExpertBook business PCs. See how a physically isolated Security Processor Unit, self-healing BIOS Recovery, chassis intrusion detection, NIST SP 800-193-aligned resilience, post-quantum cryptography, and UEFI-level media sanitization help keep your fleet protected, compliant, and future-ready.

sessions.title: Gain hybrid cloud flexibility beyond legacy virtualization
sessions.desc: Licensing changes and rising costs in legacy virtualization are prompting infrastructure teams to rethink where workloads run. See how Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2) on Azure extends the Nutanix software stack to Azure BareMetal Infrastructure. Learn how to migrate VMware workloads to Azure while preserving familiar tools, skills, and operating practices and minimizing the disruption of adopting a new stack.

sessions.title: Future of work with AI: How AI changes the workplace
sessions.desc: As enterprises navigate the next phase of digital transformation, artificial intelligence serves as an important enabler of productivity, agility, and employee experience. In this leadership conversation, Jared Spataro of Microsoft and Shishank Gupta of Infosys share insights on the digital workplace and how enterprises can prepare for a more intelligent, connected future of work.

sessions.title: HPE ProLiant Compute Premier Solutions for Azure Local
sessions.desc: Discover how HPE ProLiant Compute Premier Solutions for Azure Local simplify hybrid cloud with pre-integrated infrastructure, Azure integration, and enterprise-ready performance. Learn how these solutions help organizations modernize, scale, and deploy from edge to cloud.

sessions.title: Modernize IT service management with AI and automation
sessions.desc: AI is transforming ITSM. See how Azure AI Language and Azure AI Foundry, with deep, native integrations across Microsoft Teams, Intune, and Office 365, can help automate ticket triage, resolve requests faster, and unify service management across applications. See these capabilities in action with TeamDynamix through a no-code platform built for power without complexity and low admin overhead. Walk away with a practical, real-world blueprint for modernizing ITSM in your organization.

sessions.title: Validate continuous change at the speed of AI
sessions.desc: AI has accelerated enterprise change, but validation remains manual and slow. As remediation timelines shrink from days to hours, IT teams can face a difficult choice: delay critical updates or deploy without proof. See how Microsoft’s agent platform enables continuous, autonomous validation with governed identity, audit-ready evidence, and human approval at every critical step through a demonstration from WorkspaceDNA CTO Samit Halvadia.

sessions.title: AI SRE in production: What actually gets automated safely
sessions.desc: AIOps has moved past the demo stage and into real on-call rotations, but its effectiveness sits somewhere between the hype and the skepticism. This talk is a field report from running LLM-driven remediation in production: what it fixed, what it broke, and where automation has to stop and human judgment has to take over.

sessions.title: Take the mystery out of Autopilot enrollment
sessions.desc: An Autopilot enrollment is a black box: it either finishes, or it doesn't. Reconstructing what happened from logs on a wiped device can be difficult. See how Autopilot Monitor tracks enrollments live with 200+ signals per session, event timelines, automatic diagnostics, failure analytics, and fleet health. Through live demos, explore how companies and MSPs can investigate enrollment issues and query telemetry using an AI assistant over MCP.

sessions.title: Simplify identity and device migrations during business transformation
sessions.desc: Business mergers, acquisitions, and modernization demand speed and accuracy. Identity expert Conrad Murray demonstrates how PowerSyncPro automates AD synchronization and enables workstation migrations while preserving user profiles, apps, and identities. See the solution in action and learn how to simplify identity and device migrations while minimizing disruption.

sessions.title: Prepare for the next wave of AI and identity cyber risk
sessions.desc: Managing AI initiatives while navigating the potential risks to your cyber resilience? You aren’t alone. Agentic and generative AI are multiplying the number of non-human identities (NHIs), secrets, and access paths in your environment. Explore how these shifts are changing the risk profile of Active Directory, Entra ID, and Okta, and what IT and cybersecurity teams can do now to stay ahead of AI-related threats.

sessions.title: Govern IT at frontier pace: Endpoint readiness in an AI world
sessions.desc: AI is accelerating vulnerability discovery and shrinking the time IT teams have to respond. Can your ITOps team keep pace without sacrificing governance, security, or control? Explore why endpoint management is critical in the AI era, where automation can introduce risk, and how policy-driven operations can help your team move from reactive work to proactive endpoint readiness. See how Automox approaches Frontier Pace Governance to help IT move quickly while maintaining control.

sessions.title: Overcome the challenges of adopting AI for DevOps and SRE
sessions.desc: Coding agents have transformed how software gets written. Bringing that same impact to infrastructure operations is harder: context is scattered across tools, systems are live, and actions can affect production. Explore those challenges and see how Plural addresses them with hosted agents, connected infrastructure, and configurable permissions. Through practical examples, learn how to configure agents to investigate issues, gather evidence, and reduce manual effort.

sessions.title: Unlock more value from voice, CX, and AI
sessions.desc:
AI is changing enterprise communications, but the real opportunity comes when conversations connect to the wider business.
More insight. More efficiency. Better customer experiences.
In this session, we share three real-world examples showing how voice, conversational intelligence, workflows, and AI can improve customer experiences, automate processes, unlock actionable insights and deliver more value from your Microsoft 365 investment. Experience practical examples of what’s possible.

sessions.title: CiraSync in action: One platform, always synced
sessions.desc: One platform. Every contact. Every calendar. Every device. This live virtual demo shows how CiraSync keeps contacts and calendars connected across Microsoft 365 and employee endpoints, automatically, securely, and at enterprise scale. See how CiraSync takes manual updates and duplicate data entry off IT Teams plate, saving hours of support tickets every month while giving them one less thing to manage.

sessions.title: Strong enough for the enterprise, built for IT
sessions.desc: See how a privileged access management solution delivers the security depth large organizations demand while being designed around the people who actually run IT. Watch it in action and learn how it can simplify privileged access management for your IT teams.

sessions.title: Get trusted answers to compliance questions in Copilot
sessions.desc: AI answers are only as trustworthy as the knowledge they draw from. See how getAbstract curates and verifies knowledge across industries and job roles, then brings that knowledge into Microsoft Copilot. Explore how organizations can provide role- and sector-relevant knowledge for areas such as consulting, regulatory compliance, and financial services to help users get more grounded, trusted answers.

sessions.title: Extend Microsoft ADCS for the AI and post-quantum era
sessions.desc: Microsoft ADCS is a proven foundation, but CA sprawl, shorter certificate lifetimes, AI and post-quantum security are increasing operational pressure. Learn how Entrust helps simplify and govern ADCS environments, strengthen lifecycle management, protect critical CA keys with crypto-agile nShield HSMs, and preserve Microsoft investments while building a more resilient, post-quantum-ready PKI.

sessions.title: Strengthen identity recovery across Entra ID and hybrid environments
sessions.desc: As organizations rely more on Microsoft 365, identity is essential to business continuity. Access to email, applications, devices, collaboration, and administration depends on Microsoft Entra ID, while many organizations still operate Active Directory and hybrid identity environments. Learn where recovery gaps emerge, how administrative and synchronization failures disrupt operations, what Microsoft’s native capabilities address, and how to build a more resilient identity recovery strategy.

sessions.title: Build data security for an AI-enabled workforce
sessions.desc: Employees paste customer records, source code, and financial data into AI tools every day, often without security visibility. Learn how to protect sensitive data across an AI-enabled workforce using data classification, DLP, and DSPM, supported by identity, endpoint, and Zero Trust controls. Through a real deployment, we cover data labeling, Copilot prompt governance, and Shadow AI risk mitigation, leaving you with an L300 blueprint and actionable next steps.

sessions.title: SAP frontier transformation with AI intelligence
sessions.desc: Modernize your SAP estate with an ontology-driven intelligence layer that connects transactional data with Microsoft IQ and Microsoft Foundry. Explore how unified business ontologies connect core enterprise entities to support insights across supply chain, inventory, assets, and plant operations. Through customer case studies and demos, learn how AI systems help organizations move from reactive analytics toward proactive, automated decision processes.

sessions.title: From installer to Intune: AI-powered app packaging
sessions.desc: Every Intune admin knows the drill: download an installer, hunt for the silent switch, write a detection rule, test it, and start over when a vendor ships an update.  In this demo, Microsoft MVP Maxime Guillemin shows how an AI-powered workflow handles package creation, detection logic, validation, and built-in security checks, turning a raw installer into a validated, Intune-ready package. The result: less time spent on repetitive packaging work and a faster path from update to deployment.

sessions.title: Turn DNS and network data into actionable workflows
sessions.desc:
You run Microsoft DNS and DHCP. You also run everything else. That fragmentation leaves network and security teams with an incomplete view of what is on the network. 
This demo-led session shows how EfficientIP overlays Microsoft, Azure, and third-party DNS, adds IPAM and asset discovery, and builds one authoritative network view. See how that intelligence feeds network and security workflows to strengthen governance, reduce risk, and accelerate anomaly investigation.

sessions.title: Make agent-generated documents consistent and auditable
sessions.desc: LLMs are great at drafting but not designed for repeatable output. When AI generates a contract or invoice, consistency matters. See how Doctavian uses MCP to interpret intent, render deterministic output, and add eIDAS-compliant digital signatures and audit trails. Learn a practical approach to building consistent, compliant agent-driven document workflows in Microsoft 365 and beyond.

sessions.title: Govern Microsoft and hybrid collaboration lifecycle automation
sessions.desc: Migrating to or expanding use of Microsoft Teams is only the beginning. Learn how to move from one-time migrations to governed collaboration operations at scale. See how to unify readiness assessment, validated planning, and governed provisioning across hybrid environments with Akkadian Collaboration Lifecycle Automation Platform. Use drift detection and event-driven orchestration to help reduce risk, cut manual effort, and maintain auditable control.

sessions.title: Know when AI should yield to human judgment
sessions.desc: AI has become remarkably capable at analysis, correlation, recommendation, and prediction. Yet the closer AI gets to decisions with real operational consequences, the more administrators insist on human authority in the final dispatch. Using 2026 survey data from more than 1,000 sysadmins, this session examines where that boundary exists, why it persists, and what it tells us about the future of autonomous IT.

sessions.title: Secure AI infrastructure on Azure
sessions.desc: Securing AI infrastructure on Azure requires consistent visibility and control. In this demonstration, see how customers can gain visibility into the AI applications running in their Azure environment. Explore transitioning from discovery to enforcement using Palo Alto Networks' firewall portfolio to apply consistent, AI-powered security policies.

sessions.title: Scale governed AI from pilots to production
sessions.desc: Many organizations have piloted AI and deployed copilots, but scaling across the enterprise requires production-grade governance. This session shares frameworks for moving from experimentation to measurable impact: governance models, LLMOps/AgentOps, risk management, and human oversight. Attendees leave with practical guidance for turning AI investments into repeatable business outcomes.

sessions.title: Overcome pricing complexity and sales inefficiency in Dynamics 365
sessions.desc: Complex companies live and die by how fast they can turn a pricing decision into a quote a buyer can act on. When pricing and quoting operate separately from CRM, handoffs can add delays and slow deals. See how Conga�s pricing and CPQ solutions work within Microsoft Dynamics 365 to bring intelligent, guided selling into the sales workflow, helping teams make informed pricing and margin decisions and move from pricing to quote more efficiently.

sessions.title: Navigate Frontier Accelerate incentives to drive partner growth
sessions.desc: Identifying eligible customers, qualifying opportunities, estimating Azure growth, and managing incentives from nomination through claim approval can be complex. See how SDC, ISV, and services partners can navigate Microsoft’s Frontier Accelerate incentives with experts from TPM. Learn how partner-led models work, how Microsoft connects incentives to customer ACR, and what to know about eligibility, customer qualification, governance, and proof of execution.

sessions.title: AI-scale growth: How Hugging Face and Instacart scale in-memory data
sessions.desc: AI companies can experience rapid growth that places new demands on in-memory data infrastructure, from thread bottlenecks and resharding to tail latency and backup memory use. Explore how two teams address these challenges. Hugging Face split its Redis setup as the Hub reached 3 million models, then adopted Dragonfly to simplify operations. Instacart replaced 348 ElastiCache nodes with 100 Dragonfly nodes and reduced average and P99 latency by 40–50%, with no customer impact.

sessions.title: Is it still C#? Practical systems programming with .NET
sessions.desc: We built a database in .NET and pushed the runtime to its limits. In this session, we’ll dissect the engineering decisions we made, extracting hard-won lessons you can use to build truly high-performance software. Expect battle-tested techniques you can apply to any demanding .NET service, even if it’s not a database. Explore JSON & Beyond, The Memory Game, Taming the State Machine, Beyond Cache Line, and more.

sessions.title: Connect Microsoft 365 and the built environment
sessions.desc: Discover how to connect Microsoft 365, Microsoft Places, and Copilot to the built environment with Eptura. In this technical session, explore the architecture, data, and orchestration that turn digital context into physical workplace action. Learn how to coordinate people, buildings, rooms, desks, visitors, assets, and services through one connected experience.

sessions.title: Build governance into your Microsoft 365 migration from the start
sessions.desc: Enterprises often treat migration and governance as separate phases by moving data first and then planning to clean up permissions and compliance gaps once the dust settles. When that cleanup doesn't happen on schedule, the gap becomes a growing liability the moment AI agents and Copilot start touching that same ungoverned data. Explore how to approach migration and governance as one project and build governance into your Microsoft 365 migration from the start.

sessions.title: Teams private chat migration
sessions.desc: Microsoft Teams plays an important role in how organizations communicate and collaborate, which makes private chat history an important consideration for Microsoft 365 migrations. The Teams Private Chat Migration capability in MigrationWiz helps organizations migrate private chat history as part of a tenant-to-tenant migration.

sessions.title: From concept to containment, see the agentic SOC in practice
sessions.desc: Explore the evolution from traditional MDR to an agentic SOC through three simulated security incidents of increasing severity. Learn how machine-speed investigation and response, combined with security context, pre-authorized actions, and granular governance, enable faster threat containment without sacrificing control. sessions.desc:

We derive that math on stage, price it live against public cloud pricing APIs, and find the cascade break even that flips a saving into an overspend. Code included.
